project.title: PLAYFORM
project.subheading_zh: 兒童教育品牌、原創繪本與 3D 互動學習設計
project.subheading_en: Children's Brand, Picture Book & Interactive 3D Learning
project.status: LOCAL PROTOTYPE READY / FINAL ARTWORK HOLD
project.hero_copy_zh: PLAYFORM 將原創繪本、實體造橋教具與數位互動整合為一套兒童 STEAM 探索體驗。角色的故事引出真實的建構任務，孩子在閱讀後動手實驗，也能把觀察帶回親子對話與教室活動。
project.hero_copy_en: PLAYFORM brings original storytelling, physical bridge-building toys, and interactive digital learning into one cohesive STEAM experience. Each chapter invites children to experiment with the same ideas they encounter in the story, extending their discoveries into family conversations and classroom activities.
project.design_scope_zh: 兒童教育品牌識別／原創角色與繪本／教具包裝／3D 產品視覺／互動學習 UI/UX／家長與教師端
project.design_scope_en: Children's Brand Identity / Character & Picture-Book Design / Educational Kit & Packaging / 3D Product Visualization / Interactive Learning UX / Parent & Teacher Experiences
project.challenge_zh: 孩子的學習接觸點往往分散在不同媒介。閱讀結束後，故事中的想像未必能延續至實體操作；動手活動完成後，家長與教師也不一定知道如何引導下一次討論。PLAYFORM 以一致的角色語言與循序任務，規劃紙本、教具與數位內容之間的銜接方式。
project.challenge_en: Storybooks, building kits, and digital activities can feel like unrelated products. PLAYFORM explores how one consistent character universe and a clear learning journey can connect reading, hands-on construction, and guided reflection across home and classroom environments.
project.response_zh: 以《形狀城的第七座橋》為主線，角色路洛、比姆與琵普共同面對橋樑消失的問題。孩子閱讀角色如何測量、嘗試與修正，再使用 BRIDGE LAB 教具搭建自己的橋。網站提供可旋轉的 3D 橋樑與故事式操作任務；家長端記錄活動過程，教師端提供課程規劃與觀察欄位的示範介面。
project.response_en: In *The Seventh Bridge of Shape City*, Lulo, Bem, and Pip work together after a bridge disappears. Children observe their attempts, then build and test their own structures using the BRIDGE LAB kit. A rotatable 3D model and narrative-led digital tasks extend the experience, with complementary parent reflections and teacher lesson-planning prototypes.
project.evidence_zh: 完整品牌標誌與色彩系統、三位原創角色的角色設計、32 頁繪本腳本與編輯規劃、教具與包裝 3D 模型、四種可互動的數位閱讀／建構／任務情境，以及家長和教師端的操作原型。設計以高辨識的造型語言串接五種接觸點。
project.evidence_en: The design system spans identity assets, three original characters, a 32-page picture-book script and editorial plan, 3D learning-kit models, interactive reading and construction scenarios, and functional parent and teacher UX demonstrations.
project.commercial_value_zh: PLAYFORM 展示如何為兒童教育品牌建立可持續擴充的內容與產品架構：同一組角色、造型及視覺規則，可以發展新的繪本篇章、教育盒、數位任務與教學活動，而不需要每次重設品牌語言。
project.commercial_value_en: PLAYFORM demonstrates an extensible educational product ecosystem. A consistent character world and design language can support new stories, learning kits, digital activities, and classroom experiences without rebuilding the brand around each release.
project.scope_note_zh: 本頁展示品牌、繪本、教具與數位互動之設計提案及示範原型。實體教具未量產，材料安全與教學成效尚未驗證；家長及教師介面使用示範資料，並未蒐集真實學童個資。
project.scope_note_en: This case presents design concepts and working prototypes. Physical toys have not been manufactured or safety-certified, learning outcomes have not been independently validated, and all child-related records shown in the interface are demonstrative.

storybook.title_en: The Seventh Bridge of Shape City
storybook.format_en: Hardcover 240×240 mm / 32 pages (16 Spreads) / Ages 5–8 Shared Reading

spreads.zh: 形狀城的雨，滴答滴答，下了一整夜。早晨，河面亮晶晶的。可是，小橋不見了。
spreads.en: Rain tapped on Shape City all night. By morning, the river was bright, but the little bridge was gone.
spreads.focus_zh: 拉遠全景；河的兩端出現空白
spreads.focus_en: Wide landscape; empty river gap between shores

spreads.zh: 路洛站在岸邊，往前看，又往後看。「沒有橋，要怎麼過去呢？」
spreads.en: Lulo looked across the river, then back at the road. “How will we get across?”
spreads.focus_zh: 路洛表情困惑，河流從視覺中間切開
spreads.focus_en: Lulo looks puzzled; river cuts through the middle

spreads.zh: 「我們先量量看。」比姆拿出小量尺，一步、兩步、三步。
spreads.en: “Let's measure first,” said Bem. Step, step, step went the little ruler.
spreads.focus_zh: 比姆沿河岸測量，畫面可見標示
spreads.focus_en: Bem measures along the bank with clear marks

spreads.zh: 琵普滾來一個圓圓的積木。「這個可以嗎？」它一路滾向草地。
spreads.en: Pip brought a round block. “What about this?” It rolled away into the grass.
spreads.focus_zh: 有速度線和幽默轉場；不貶低圓形用途
spreads.focus_en: Motion lines and humor; highlights rolling property

spreads.zh: 比姆擺好一塊方方的積木。路洛問：「如果站在它上面呢？」
spreads.en: Bem placed a square block on the ground. “Could this hold something up?” Lulo asked.
spreads.focus_zh: 穩定靜物對照；角色停下觀察
spreads.focus_en: Stable block contrast; characters pause to inspect

spreads.zh: 琵普拿起一個三角形。「角角可以連在一起。」三個朋友靠近看。
spreads.en: Pip lifted a triangle. “These corners can meet.” The friends leaned closer.
spreads.focus_zh: 放大三角與接點；幾何不是唯一解法
spreads.focus_en: Close up on triangle joints and apexes

spreads.zh: 「先在兩邊，蓋起橋墩！」路洛和琵普把積木一塊塊排好。
spreads.en: “Let's start with supports on both sides!” Lulo and Pip stacked their blocks.
spreads.focus_zh: 兩岸起建；積木有明確前後層次
spreads.focus_en: Building from both shores; clear depth and layering

spreads.zh: 比姆把橋拱慢慢放上去。它像一道微笑，跨過了水面。
spreads.en: Bem gently placed the arch. It looked like a smile above the water.
spreads.focus_zh: 拱形首次完整出現，讀者有驚喜
spreads.focus_en: Arch spans water for the first time like a smile

spreads.zh: 橋面放好了。可是，左邊翹了起來。「等一下，還不能走！」
spreads.en: The deck was in place. But one side tipped up. “Wait! We're not ready yet.”
spreads.focus_zh: 失敗不是危險事故；角色停下

spreads.zh: 他們退後一點，看了又看。「原來橋墩沒有對齊。」
spreads.en: They stepped back for another look. “The supports aren't lined up.”
spreads.focus_zh: 鏡頭變遠，焦點回到支撐位置
spreads.focus_en: Distant view focusing on pier alignment gap

spreads.zh: 路洛扶住橋拱，比姆調整距離，琵普把積木推回正中間。
spreads.en: Lulo held the arch. Bem adjusted the gap. Pip nudged the blocks into place.
spreads.focus_zh: 三角色協力；各自發揮長處
spreads.focus_en: Three friends working in unison with unique strengths

spreads.zh: 他們先放上一塊小積木。橋沒有晃。再放第二塊，橋還是穩穩的。
spreads.en: They tried one little block. The bridge stayed steady. Then a second—still steady.

spreads.zh: 「我們成功了嗎？」琵普問。比姆笑著說：「我們還可以再檢查一次。」
spreads.en: “Did we do it?” asked Pip. Bem smiled. “Let's check one more time.”

spreads.zh: 三個朋友走到橋邊。路洛說：「原來，重新試一次，也是一種辦法。」
spreads.en: The friends stood by the bridge. “Trying again is part of figuring it out,” said Lulo.
spreads.focus_zh: 黃昏橋的剪影；創作自信感
spreads.focus_en: Dusk silhouette of the bridge; creative confidence

spreads.zh: 小橋把兩岸連在一起。路過的人揮揮手，說了聲：「謝謝！」
spreads.en: The bridge joined both riverbanks. A traveler waved and called, “Thank you!”
spreads.focus_zh: 橋真正有社會用途；構圖呼應開場
spreads.focus_en: Bridge fulfills its community purpose; echoes intro

spreads.zh: 第二天，形狀城飄來一朵奇怪的雲。「下一次，我們要蓋什麼？」
spreads.en: The next morning, a curious cloud drifted over Shape City. “What shall we build next?”
spreads.focus_zh: 一點未解之謎，開啟下一冊主題
spreads.focus_en: Open mystery inviting the next kit story
spreads.activity_zh: 回到現實教具自由創作

learning_missions.title_zh: 任務 01：找出能形成支撐的形狀
learning_missions.instruction_zh: 點選一個積木形狀，看看哪個形狀在受到力量時不容易變形，最適合當作穩定結構的起點？
learning_missions.instruction_en: Tap a shape to see which one holds its angle and provides the most stable foundation for a bridge.

choices.feedback_zh: 圓形在地上會咕嚕咕嚕滾動。它很適合用來做車輪，但當底座時需要額外的支架來固定。
choices.feedback_en: Circles roll freely! Great for wheels, but tricky for stationary bridge pillars without extra braces.

choices.feedback_zh: 正方形有平整的面，放在地面很穩固。但受到側面的推力時，四個角可能會稍微傾斜。
choices.feedback_en: Squares have flat surfaces for a steady base, but side forces can push their corners out of square.

choices.feedback_zh: 太棒了！三角形的三個頂角互相鎖定，受力時最不容易改變形狀，是真實橋樑桁架中最常見的幾何！
choices.feedback_en: Spot on! The three corners of a triangle lock together, resisting deformation—the secret behind real trusses!

learning_missions.instruction_zh: 橋拱需要兩側均勻的承托。請選擇讓橋拱兩端同時受力的位置。
learning_missions.instruction_en: The arch needs equal support on both banks. Choose the position where forces balance evenly.

choices.feedback_zh: 如果只有一邊有支撐，橋拱放上去會因為失去重心而滑落。
choices.feedback_en: With only one side supported, the arch slides down into the river.

choices.feedback_zh: 非常棒！兩岸橋墩距離對齊後，橋拱就能像一道微笑穩穩跨過河流！
choices.feedback_en: Excellent! When both piers align, the arch spans gracefully across the river like a smile.

learning_missions.title_zh: 任務 03：漸進放置測試積木
learning_missions.instruction_zh: 放上一塊測試積木，觀察橋樑的平衡狀態。
learning_missions.instruction_en: Place test blocks onto the deck to verify steady equilibrium.

choices.feedback_zh: 第一塊積木放上了，橋面保持平穩，沒有晃動！
choices.feedback_en: First block placed! The deck remains perfectly balanced without wobbling.

choices.feedback_zh: 第二塊積木放上了，橋樑依然穩固！測試順利完成！
choices.feedback_en: Second block placed! The bridge holds firm. Load test completed!

parent_dashboard.observation_summary_zh: 孩子完成了形狀探索與橋拱搭建，主動觀察了三角形與圓形在受力時的差異，並在失敗後嘗試調整支點。
parent_dashboard.observation_summary_en: The child explored structural shapes, observed differences between triangles and rolling circles, and adjusted support positions after an initial tilt.
reflection_questions_zh: 「為什麼圓形的積木滾走了，但三角形可以站得好好的？」
「如果橋的兩邊不一樣高，可以怎麼調整？」
「在我們生活周遭，你在哪裡看過三角形的鋼架？」
reflection_questions_en: “Why did the round block roll away, while the triangle stood firm?”
“What could we adjust if one side of the bridge is higher than the other?”
“Where do you see triangle frames in real buildings around us?”
